name: ws
purpose: Minimal RFC 6455 WebSocket server transport for the standalone trusted-friends multiplayer service.
licenseEvidence: npm registry metadata from `pnpm view ws@8.21.1 license repository.url time --json` reported MIT and git+https://github.com/websockets/ws.git; the project repository documents MIT licensing.
wellKnownEvidence: ws is the maintained WebSocket client/server implementation used directly with Node HTTP servers; version 8.21.2 was deliberately not adopted because it was published within the repository's three-day freshness exclusion window.
